theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_sos_mt_cc_support_subset_iff_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (F : Set (Euclid P)), R.Represents T → IsClosed F → (T.support ⊆ F ↔ R.measure Fᶜ = 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
